# Input

Atlas text input with a stacked label. Loosely typed on purpose — the props type is inline and `type` is an open string.

Import: `import { Input } from '@ds/react';` — the only public entry point.

Static component (no react-aria-components base) — plain semantic HTML.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `error` | `string` | no | — | Error message; when set the input gets the error border. |
| `label` | `string` | yes | — | Visible label rendered above the control. |
| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void` | no | — |  |
| `type` | `string` | no | — | Native input type (free-form string — legacy API). |
| `value` | `string` | no | — |  |

## Accessibility

- Static component rendered as plain semantic HTML; roles/ARIA are set by the component where needed (see description).
- Color pairs used by this system are contrast-audited (WCAG 2.2 AA (normal text)); see registries/contrast-report.json. Only audited foreground/background token pairs are legal.

## Examples

